attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "This reverts a bugfix that restricted drag-drop of widgets to compatible content types between BagPart/FlowPart containers, removing that validation and reintroducing the original bug (#13068) which could allow invalid widget types to be dropped into containers that don't support them, affecting content editing UI across all tenants using Flow/Bag parts."}

reason: This reverts a bugfix that restricted drag-drop of widgets to compatible content types between BagPart/FlowPart containers, removing that validation and reintroducing the original bug (#13068) which could allow invalid widget types to be dropped into containers that don't support them, affecting content editing UI across all tenants using Flow/Bag parts.
